Epgs.Title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook: The Mushroom Route

Epgs.Title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook: The Chestnut Route
Epgs.ShortDescription: Julie takes to the road in her little red car to honour one of her favourite fruits: the chestnut.

Epgs.Title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook: The Cheese Menu
Epgs.ShortDescription: More than a gourmet craze, more than an end-of-meal treat, cheese is associated with French gastronomy.

Epgs.Title: Luana's Kitchen: Saffron
Epgs.ShortDescription: With her friend Myriam, Luana Belmondo prepares two saffron-based recipes. On the program: orecchiette (small Italian pasta) with sausage, and monkfish with lemon confit and asparagus purée.

Epgs.Title: Luana's Kitchen: American cuisine with Miss Maggie
Epgs.ShortDescription: In Normandy, Luana Belmondo welcomes Héloïse Brion (Miss Maggie's Kitchen). Together, they will cook two American recipes: squash stuffed with apple and pecan pie.

Epgs.Title: Earth from Above: USA: The end of oil

Epgs.Title: Yoga

Epgs.Title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook: Poultry on the menu

Epgs.Title: Luana's Kitchen: Desserts from my Childhood

Epgs.Title: My Day Dubai: Park Hyatt
Epgs.ShortDescription: In this episode, Gabriela is at the Park Hyatt hotel with Sia Manzano. The two women will take a golf lesson, enjoy the spa and take a cooking class.

Epgs.Title: My Day Dubai: Omnia Gourmet
Epgs.ShortDescription: In this episode, Gabriela will go to the Dubai Farmer's Market before chef Silvena Rowe present her her vegan and gluten-free restaurant Omnia Gourmet. Then she'll take a catamaran lesson.

Epgs.Title: My Day Dubai: Nikki Beach
Epgs.ShortDescription: In this episode, Gabriela begins her day with a workout on the beach at the Nikki Beach Resort. She then participates in a surf lesson, before sampling Caribbean recipes with Chef Olivier Key West.

Epgs.Title: My Day Dubai: Rixos the Palm
Epgs.ShortDescription: In this episode, Gabriela will go to the desert to take a riding lesson, and she will enjoy the spa and aqua fitness at Rixos The Palm. She will test the Kangoo Jumping, as well as the cuisine at El Chiringuito restaurant with Chef Diego.

Epgs.Title: My Day Dubai: The Retreat
Epgs.ShortDescription: In this episode, Gabriela is at The Retreat Wellness Hotel where she meets Dr. Grace. She then tests the wellness cuisine with Chef Pat, before taking Eco Gulf classes and finishing with a slimming yoga session.

Epgs.Title: My Day Dubai: Life'n'One
Epgs.ShortDescription: In this episode, Gabriela will taste vegan food. She will then go to the Life'n'One wellness center before taking wake surfing lessons in Dubai Marina.

Epgs.Title: Beautiful Landscapes

Epgs.Title: Namaste Yoga: Grace And Gratitude: Backbending
Epgs.ShortDescription: A joyous and elegant sequence, Grace and Gratitude opens the front of your body with a series of dynamic backbends.

Epgs.Title: Home training: Deep muscles, legs & buttocks
Epgs.ShortDescription: In this episode, Guillaume and Sabrina focus on balance and proprioception exercises. The goal is to engage the deep muscles, especially the abdominal muscles, for deep strengthening.

Epgs.Title: Pilates
Epgs.ShortDescription: Pilates is a low-impact exercise that focuses on core strength, flexibility, and body control through precise, mindful movements.

Epgs.Title: Namaste Yoga: Hand Balancing and Hip Opening
Epgs.ShortDescription: Arrive at your practice, prepared to be where you are. Strong, Slow and Steady moves you through that ever-challenging Crow Pose, while guiding you to the realization that you cannot fail to be where you already are.

Epgs.Title: Deco Masters: Week 01 _ Day 02
Epgs.ShortDescription: Today it's Pupa's turn. This 29-year-old from Liège has been immersed in the art world since she was a child. But beneath her calm, smiling exterior, Pupa has quite a character.

Epgs.Title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook: Shellfish on the menu
Epgs.ShortDescription: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. Head for Brittany, Normandy and Corsica to cook lobster, crab and langoustines.

Epgs.Title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook: The taste of honey
Epgs.ShortDescription: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been used as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir and lavender...

Epgs.Title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook: Fish on the Menu
Epgs.ShortDescription: Julie takes us to the southern Brittany and more precisely the maritime district of Guilvinec to follow the fish route from the nets to your plate.
